labels.description: Free-form labels for selecting and grouping.

name.description:
Unique among resources of one kind: lowercase letters, digits, "-" and
 "_". Required.

bearing.config.v1alpha1.Source.schema.js.description: Source is one configured instance of an adapter, the unit of provenance.

metadata.description:
The source's name, for example "github-acme". It may not be "manual"
 or start with "core/".

bearing.config.v1alpha1.Source.schema.js.title: Source

^(webhookSecret)$.description:
Secret reference, in the form secrets accepts, for the key the source
 signs its webhook deliveries with. It is separate from secrets because
 only the host reads it: an adapter never asks for it or receives it.
 Empty: the source cannot push events, and its webhooks are refused once
 the server runs. Ignored when the adapter declares no webhook.

adapter.description: The adapter it runs, by name from the settings' adapters. Required.

schedule.description:
Time between scheduled syncs, an ISO 8601 duration such as "PT1H".
 Empty: webhooks and manual syncs only.

secrets.description:
Secret references by the name of the environment variable the adapter
 reads the secret from (the key, such as GITHUB_TOKEN or
 AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY): "env:NAME". Never values.

settings.description: Its settings, checked against the adapter's declared settings.

webhook_secret.description:
Secret reference, in the form secrets accepts, for the key the source
 signs its webhook deliveries with. It is separate from secrets because
 only the host reads it: an adapter never asks for it or receives it.
 Empty: the source cannot push events, and its webhooks are refused once
 the server runs. Ignored when the adapter declares no webhook.
